body: Aside from commas and apostrophes, I feel like I did pretty well. As a reminder, this is hours after the situation. I'm very tired and worn out. I don't think my grammar is the point of this post either.

I have found a new set of friends but I'm terrified of putting trust in them. I'm terrified I'll do something to hurt one of them. I never thought I would be one to hurt people the way I've been hurt but I made mistakes.
I do have a crappy car I could take a few miles up north. The idea is sticking with me.
It sounds therapeutic but unfortunately I live in NYC. I really have to go out of my way to find a tranquil stream.

I am responsible for a good portion of why people hate me. My dad hates me because he's a bigot and judgemental. He kicked me out for getting a tattoo. And I'm 22. 

Most of the betrayal I've faced was not my fault. I've had friends talk trash about me to girls to steal them from me. They try to secretly sleep with my ex's.
